# VisionaryAds

> VisionaryAds LLC runs Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns for construction, plumbing, and home-improvement businesses across the United States, and also builds websites for the same audience. It is a solo operation founded and run by Aidan Radford, based in North Carolina, who personally worked in construction, plumbing, and home improvement before starting the company.

## Services

- **Ad management**: Facebook and Instagram advertising for construction, plumbing, and home-improvement businesses of any size. Process: a form, then a real call, then a rough draft reviewed on video call before anything goes live, then ongoing management (contract or a no-contract trial retainer). Pricing is a flat retainer or a percentage of ad spend, discussed on the call.
- **Website builds**: Flat $1,000 per site, 3-5 business day turnaround, optional $250/month maintenance. Built specifically for construction, plumbing, and home-improvement businesses.

## Who it's for

Construction, plumbing, and home-improvement businesses of any size, either with a few completed jobs already or real ad budget set aside if just starting out. Based in North Carolina, serving clients nationwide.
